title: Risk & Internal Controls Manager
description:
About the Role

EBANX is seeking a highly skilled Manager of Risk to lead our enterprise risk management framework, oversee internal controls, and strengthen the company’s overall risk culture. This role plays a key part in ensuring that EBANX maintains robust, scalable, and efficient processes that support business growth while mitigating financial, operational, regulatory, and strategic risks.

The ideal candidate is analytical, proactive, collaborative, and experienced in risk management within payments, fintech, banking, or other highly regulated industries.

Key Responsibilities
  • Risk Management
    • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of EBANX’s risk management framework.
    • Identify, assess, monitor, and report on the company’s key risk exposures—financial, operational, compliance, and strategic.
    • Partner with business units to design, monitor, and validate appropriate controls and mitigation strategies.
    • Develop and maintain risk dashboards, indicators (KRIs), methodologies, and risk appetite alignment.
    • Conduct periodic risk assessments and facilitate risk workshops across the organization.
    • Support executive leadership and governance committees with risk insights and reporting.
  • Internal Controls & Compliance
    • Lead the Internal Control function, ensuring the effectiveness and reliability of end-to-end processes.
    • Oversee the creation, documentation, and testing of internal controls (including SOX‑like controls if applicable).
    • Collaborate with Compliance, Finance, Operations, Technology, and Legal teams to ensure processes adhere to regulatory and company standards.
    • Identify control gaps and oversee remediation plans.
  • Leadership & Collaboration
    • Manage and develop the risk and internal control team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
    • Strengthen risk awareness across business areas through training, communication, and partnership.
    • Work closely with internal audit and external auditors to ensure alignment and successful reviews.
  • Analysis & Reporting
    • Prepare accurate and meaningful risk reports for senior management and the board.
    • Track trends, emerging risks, and market signals relevant to the payments and fintech ecosystem.
    • Support strategic decision‑making by providing risk‑based perspectives.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related fields.
  • Proven experience (typically 6+ years) in risk management , internal controls, audit, compliance, or related functions—preferably in fintech, payments, banking, or technology companies.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise risk frameworks, operational risk practices, and internal controls.
  • Experience leading teams and managing stakeholders at multiple levels.
  • Excellent data analysis skills; ability to work with dashboards, metrics, and structured methodologies.
  • Fluent English (mandatory).
  • Spanish (desired).
  • Availability to be based in Curitiba or São Paulo .
Desired Skills
  • Familiarity with fraud risk, financial risk, or payment‑industry risk solutions is a plus.
  • Strong communication, influencing, and relationship‑building skills.
  • Ability to operate in high‑growth, fast‑paced environments.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with the ability to balance detail‑orientation and strategic thinking.
Why Join EBANX?
  • Opportunity to work in one of the most innovative payment technology companies in Latin America.
  • Collaborative, multicultural environment with a strong focus on growth.
  • Real impact on improving processes, scalability, and governance across the company.

Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team’s immediate gap.

As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team‑matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges.

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.

You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
  • Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.

title: Tax Manager - Brazil
description:
Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer‑centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

We are looking for an experienced Tax Manager – Brazil to lead Brazilian tax compliance and transactional tax matters, ensuring full adherence to federal, state, and municipal regulations. This role will be responsible for reviewing tax filings, managing tax risks, overseeing local tax analysts, and partnering closely with regional and global tax teams to ensure strong internal controls and efficient tax processes across dLocal’s Brazilian operations.

What will you do? Tax Compliance & Review
  • Review and validate Brazilian tax returns at federal, state, and municipal levels (IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS, ICMS, among others)
  • Ensure accurate calculation and reporting of withholding taxes (IRRF, PIS/COFINS/CSLL, INSS, ISS)
  • Oversee tax account reconciliations and support monthly and quarterly closings
  • Ensure timely and accurate tax filings and payments in compliance with local regulations
Transactional Taxes & IOF
  • Manage and review transactional taxes applicable to international merchants, with a strong focus on IOF (Imposto sobre Operações Financeiras)
  • Ensure correct IOF application and rate determination across FX, credit operations, remittances, and cross‑border transaction flows
  • Review IOF reporting, reconciliations, filings, and supporting documentation
  • Partner with Product, Payments, Treasury, and Operations teams to assess tax impacts of new transaction flows and operational changes
  • Monitor regulatory changes impacting IOF and other transactional taxes
Tax Control, Advisory & Monitoring
  • Prepare consolidated tax information, including withholdings, payments, and tax credits
  • Monitor tax positions and exposures, identifying risks and ensuring appropriate documentation
  • Provide tax guidance on incentives, deductions, credits, and regulatory requirements
  • Support new product launches and business initiatives from a tax perspective
  • Analyze Brazilian tax reform and assess its impact on dLocal’s operations, recommending necessary changes
Stakeholder & Authority Management
  • Manage interactions with tax authorities (RFB, SEFAZ, and municipalities)
  • Coordinate with external tax advisors to ensure high‑quality compliance and advisory support
  • Work closely with Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations to ensure proper tax treatment and reporting
Internal Controls & Continuous Improvement
  • Maintain and enhance internal tax controls aligned with global standards
  • Develop, document, and update tax policies and operational procedures
  • Identify opportunities to streamline tax processes and improve efficiency
  • Stay up to date with changes in Brazilian tax legislation, especially those impacting cross‑border payments
What skills do you need?
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field
  • 9+ years of experience in Brazilian tax, ideally within fintech, payments, technology, or multinational environments
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian tax regulations, including IRPJ/CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS, ICMS, IOF, eSocial, ECD/ECF, DCTFWeb
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability for deliverables
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus
  • Experience working with ERPs and tax automation tools; SAP experience is a strong plus
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast‑paced environment
Nice to have
  • Experience in fintech, technology, or payments companies
  • Previous experience leading, mentoring, or supervising junior team members
  • Exposure to cross‑border tax matters and multinational structures
What do we offer?
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever‑evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

Flexibility in how you work: We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Coordenador Administrativo | Matinhos e Pontal do Paraná
description:
Educar é um ato de responsabilidade moral, social e transformadora.

Na APG GOV , acreditamos que fortalecer a educação pública é um dos caminhos mais potentes para gerar impacto real no país. Atuamos ao lado de diretores e equipes pedagógicas da Rede Pública do Paraná, oferecendo um modelo de gestão que amplia a eficiência, impulsiona a inovação e fortalece o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

Criada em 2023 a partir da Rede APOGEU, reconhecida por sua excelência acadêmica e mais de 4.600 aprovações em universidades públicas, a APG GOV nasceu com um propósito claro: apoiar a gestão escolar para que os educadores possam dedicar mais tempo ao que realmente importa: o aprendizado e o desenvolvimento dos estudantes.

Estamos em busca de profissionais comprometidos com o impacto social, apaixonados pela educação pública e dispostos a construir, junto conosco, uma comunidade escolar forte, acolhedora e inovadora.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Coordenador Administrativo é responsável por liderar a gestão administrativa e operacional de uma escola pública estadual, garantindo o funcionamento eficiente e a conformidade com as políticas e diretrizes da APG GOV e das autoridades públicas. Este profissional tem como missão principal resolver as questões não pedagógicas da escola, assegurando que estas estejam alinhadas às necessidades da comunidade escolar e dos objetivos educacionais.

O profissional irá atuar em parceria com o Diretor Pedagógico, para impulsionar projetos e iniciativas que aumentem a frequência e o aprendizado dos estudantes, enquanto assegura um ambiente escolar organizado, seguro e funcional. Sua atuação administrativa de excelência garante que professores e diretores pedagógicos possam se concentrar no que mais importa: o desenvolvimento dos alunos.

Atividades:

  • Apoiar na elaboração do Plano de Trabalho, em colaboração com o Diretor Escolar;
  • Executar e acompanhar as ações previstas no Plano de Trabalho apresentado pela APG GOV;
  • Relatar o avanço do Plano de Trabalho quinzenalmente ao Diretor Escolar, comunicando de forma ágil qualquer problema que venha a interferir na execução do Plano e na qualidade do serviço prestado;
  • Zelar pelo patrimônio da instituição de ensino, promovendo a higienização, manutenção e a reposição dos equipamentos e materiais existentes;
  • Garantir a limpeza, higienização, sanitização e manutenção dos espaços escolares contemplando a contratação e a coordenação dos profissionais, bem como adquirir equipamentos e produtos adequados para a execução do serviço;
  • Acompanhar, em alinhamento com o profissional de nutrição, o fornecimento da alimentação escolar, considerando os suprimentos oriundos do Instituto Fundepar e da Agricultura Familiar, bem como prover a complementação dos insumos, caso necessário;
  • Realizar as devidas contratações de todos os profissionais necessários à prestação dos serviços;
  • Supervisionar a frequência, a jornada de trabalho e o desempenho de todos os profissionais contratados pela APG GOV, promovendo eventuais substituições de qualquer caráter, temporária ou definitiva, mantendo total atendimento às demandas da Escola;
  • Fiscalizar a utilização dos Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI), sempre que houver a obrigatoriedade para o uso, bem como os registros de frequência de seus funcionários;
  • Gerenciar e Orientar sobre a utilização correta de todos os recursos tecnológicos da escola, incluindo equipamentos, software e conectividade;
  • Zelar pelas políticas de segurança aplicadas aos equipamentos e soluções tecnológicas da escola;
  • Adquirir, distribuir e manter em condições de uso satisfatório os recursos necessários para o funcionamento da escola, nos âmbitos pedagógico, administrativo e operacional;
  • Promover condições de gerenciamento, organização e armazenamento adequado da documentação escolar, incluindo registros acadêmicos, financeiros e administrativos;
  • Prover condições de segurança a instituições de ensino, bem como apoiar ações de melhorias do clima escolar e comunicação junto à comunidade escolar;
  • Efetivar as demais ações relativas à gestão administrativa e financeira a fim de garantir a execução integral das obrigações contratuais previstas no Edital.
Requisitos e qualificações

Para o exercício da função de Coordenador Administrativo, exige-se formação superior completa e, preferencialmente, especialização (lato sensu ou stricto sensu) na área de Gestão Escolar. Embora não sejam exigidos outros requisitos formais, o cargo requer uma abordagem versátil e a aplicação de diversas competências profissionais, incluindo:

  • Liderança Inspiradora: Habilidade para coordenar equipes, fomentar um ambiente de colaboração e engajar os colaboradores no alcance de objetivos estratégicos.
  • Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: Capacidade de estruturar e gerenciar diferentes demandas simultaneamente, garantindo a eficiência nas operações administrativas.
  • Comunicação Estratégica: Facilidade para transmitir informações de forma clara e eficaz, tanto oralmente quanto por escrito, interagindo com pais, professores, alunos e autoridades de maneira assertiva.
  • Solução de Problemas: Proatividade para diagnosticar desafios e implementar soluções práticas que agreguem valor ao dia a dia da escola.
  • Relações Humanas Positivas: Sensibilidade para entender e atender às necessidades da comunidade escolar, construindo conexões sólidas baseadas em empatia e confiança.
Informações adicionais

Remuneração:

  • Escolas P, até 599 alunos - R$ 3.500 (com uma variação de R$ 3.000 a R$ 4.000, a depender dos CRITÉRIOS abaixo);
  • Escolas M, de 600 até 999 alunos - R$ 4.500 (com uma variação de R$ 3.600 a R$ 5.200, a depender dos CRITÉRIOS abaixo);
  • Escolas G, acima de 1000 alunos - R$ 5.500 (com uma variação de R$ 4.300 a R$ 7.000, a depender dos CRITÉRIOS abaixo).

Benefício:

  • R$ 1.737,00.

Critérios:

  • Experiência do Candidato;
  • Desafio da escola (interior, outras complexidades).

Obs.: Contagem de tamanho da escola, quando for integral, consideramos alunos x2.

Regime de contratação: CLT

Cadastro e Comunicação
  • Utilize seu e-mail e telefone principais no momento da inscrição, pois todos os comunicados oficiais serão enviados pelos contatos cadastrados.
  • Entramos em contato via e-mail e WhatsApp, portanto, fique atento a sua caixa de spam e às suas mensagens no seu celular.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  1. Cadastro
  2. Triagem
  3. Prova Online
  4. Fit Cultural
  5. Agendamento de Case e Entrevista
  6. Assessment - (DISC)
  7. Entrevista Final
  8. Contratação

As pontuações não são divulgadas e os candidatos avançam conforme pontuação nas etapas.

Inclusão e Diversidade

Valorizamos a equidade, a diversidade e a inclusão em nossa cultura organizacional. Todas as vagas são abertas a todos os públicos.

Documentação Obrigatória (para contratação)
  • RG e CPF
  • Diploma ou certidão de conclusão da escolaridade
  • Certidão de antecedentes criminais atualizada

Conforme Lei nº 14.811/2024, garantindo proteção e segurança a crianças e adolescentes.

⚖️ Compliance e Política de Parentesco

Em conformidade com a LGPD, verificamos vínculos de parentesco para garantir transparência e integridade no processo.

Ter parentes na instituição não impede a candidatura , mas respeitamos as seguintes restrições:

  • Não contratamos parentes até 3º grau do(a) diretor(a) escolar para a mesma unidade.
  • Não contratamos parentes de 1º grau em relação de subordinação direta.

Todas as informações são tratadas com sigilo.

Nossa Identidade e Propósito

Somos uma rede de educadores e gestores que acredita no poder transformador da educação pública. Atuamos com compromisso profundo, disciplina, inovação e responsabilidade social.

Nossa missão é construir uma comunidade verdadeiramente comprometida com o desenvolvimento dos estudantes, fortalecendo a gestão escolar e criando condições para que cada criança e jovem tenha oportunidades reais de sonhar, aprender e conquistar seus objetivos.

Por que trabalhar na APG GOV?
  • Impacto: Seu trabalho contribui diretamente para transformar a educação pública e ampliar oportunidades para milhares de estudantes.
  • Desenvolvimento: Acreditamos no crescimento constante dos nossos profissionais, com acompanhamento, troca e formação contínua.
  • Inovação: Você fará parte de um ambiente que incentiva metodologias ativas, tecnologias educacionais e soluções criativas.
  • Comunidade: Trabalhamos juntos com corresponsabilidade, diálogo e compromisso com o nosso propósito.
Venha fazer parte dessa transformação!

Se você é apaixonado pela educação, acredita no impacto da escola pública e deseja contribuir para um projeto de grande relevância social, queremos você com a gente.

Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte da APG GOV!

Descrição da vaga

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Arquitetar e evoluir a infraestrutura de inferência e suporte a treinamento e fine-tuning de modelos, com abordagemGPU-first , considerando ambientes on-premises, cloud e serviços externos quando aplicável.
  • Definir a arquitetura do ambiente, incluindo topologias de rede, isolamento de workloads, alta disponibilidade, capacidade e resiliência.
  • Planejar e executar a implantação da plataforma de IA, garantindo compatibilidade entre hardware, sistema operacional, drivers, stacks CUDA (ou equivalentes), Kubernetes e plataformas de inferência.
  • Operar e sustentar a plataforma de inferência em produção, assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e continuidade operacional (em escopo de arquitetura estratégica).
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de ações de melhoria decorrentes de incidentes complexos envolvendo GPUs, Kubernetes, redes, storage e workloads de inferência.
  • Aplicar práticas de SRE, incluindo definição e acompanhamento de SLOs, SLIs, error budgets e gestão de incidentes.
  • Operar e evoluir stacks de inferência comerciais e open source (ex.: NVIDIA AI Enterprise, Triton, vLLM, KServe), garantindo portabilidade e mitigação de lock-in.
  • Definir e padronizar o uso de serviços de inferência quando aplicável (ex.: Triton, NIM).
  • Arquitetar e operar clusters Kubernetes para workloads de IA, com foco em isolamento multi-tenant, GPU scheduling, concorrência, filas, backpressure e escalabilidade.
  • Implementar observabilidade full stack, abrangendo infraestrutura, GPUs, Kubernetes e serviços de inferência.
  • Garantir visibilidade sobre consumo de recursos, capacidade, riscos operacionais e impacto financeiro das cargas de IA.
  • Apoiar processos de capacity planning e planejamento orçamentário, avaliando trade-offs entre soluções comerciais e open source.
  • Integrar práticas de DevSecOps desde a concepção até a operação da plataforma.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança, auditoria, controle de acesso e segregação de ambientes.
  • Disseminar padrões técnicos, boas práticas e conhecimento por meio de documentação estruturada e mentorias técnicas.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente fóruns internos e processos decisórios relacionados à infraestrutura de IA.
Requisitos e qualificações Experiência
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em infraestrutura de TI, cloud ou plataformas distribuídas, com atuação em ambientes críticos.
  • Experiência comprovada em arquitetura e operação de sistemas distribuídos, preferencialmente com workloads de dados, analytics ou IA.

title: International IT Technical Product Manager
description:
Job Description

**This position is for work in an on‑site format, in Contagem - MG.**

Who will you be working with?

You will work closely with the **Director of BU Solutions** and collaborate across Infrastructure, Operations, Security, and multiple business units to deliver IT projects that support Freight Components operations across more than 35 sites globally.

How will you make a difference?

As an International IT Technical Product Manager, you will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex IT projects, ensuring they are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with strategic objectives. Your work will directly support ERP modernization, application lifecycle roadmaps, and initiatives that enhance operational resilience and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
  • Program Management: Manage end‑to‑end delivery of IT projects, including ERP upgrades, application enhancements, digital integration initiatives.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and resource allocations; monitor progress and adjust as needed.
  • Ensure adherence to corporate project management standards and methodologies.
  • Provide technical guidance on application modernization, ERP systems (Syspro, Epicor Kinetix), and integration projects.
  • Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure project success.
  • Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary point of contact for project‑related communications with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Build strong relationships with site leaders and cross‑functional teams to ensure alignment and adoption of solutions.
  • Prepare and present project status reports to senior leadership.
  • Operational Support: Support the Director in managing operational escalations related to project deliverables.
  • Assist in optimizing the application portfolio by identifying opportunities for standardization and efficiency.
  • Support management of programs and related operations, budgets and vendors needed for engagements.
What do we want to know about you? Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related STEM field.
  • Extensive experience in IT project management with a focus on technical solutions.
  • Proven track record in ERP systems, application modernization, and integration projects.
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English.
Preferred
  • Experience in manufacturing or industrial sectors.
  • Familiarity with supply chain systems and digital integration initiatives.
  • Ability to manage complex IT programs and horizontal stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to make decisions with incomplete or conflicting information.
What will your typical day look like?
  • Lead multiple IT projects from initiation through delivery.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable technical solutions.
  • Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure compliance with performance and security standards.
  • Communicate regularly with stakeholders and provide status updates to senior leadership.
Work Environment
  • On‑site work model: 5 days onsite at Wabtec office.
  • Occasional travel to global sites.
Benefits
  • Medical Assistance extended to dependents (spouse and children)
  • Dental Assistance extended to dependents (spouse and children)
  • Profit Sharing
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Policy according to location
  • Life Insurance

  • Program for Pregnant Women and Babies

  • Pharmacy Assistance
Additional Information

What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?

At Wabtec, it's not just about a job - it's about the impact you make. When our people come together, we're Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we it does - for our clients and each other.

If you're ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you.

Who are we?

Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value‑added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it's freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together - are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike.

Our global team of about 30,000 employees worldwide delivers performance that moves the world forward. We're lifelong learners, obsessed with better. Learn more at

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of experiences and backgrounds. At Wabtec, we strive every day to create a place where everyone belongs. We're building a culture where leadership, inclusion and your unique perspective fuel progress.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome talent of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including race, gender, age, disability, veteran status and more.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
Job Description

Terracon is seeking a Senior Geotechnical Engineer to support our Transportation practice. This group supports complex transportation and infrastructure projects including highways, bridges, and public works all across Northern and Central California. This position can be based out of our East Bay, Lodi, Concord, San Jose or Sacramento offices!

General Responsibilities

In this role you will provide engineering and consulting services for transportation projects and clients. This may include performing and/or leading field investigations, engineering analysis, calculations, and recommendations, design and development of plans and specifications, observation and inspection, and the writing, preparation, and review of related reports for the services provided. Review drawings and construction to assure compliance with plans and specifications. Prepare proposals and cost estimates, track and evaluate project progress, budgets, and recommend changes. Research and resolve design and construction problems. Assign, review, and evaluate laboratory or field data for inclusion in reports. Apply sound engineering principles and be able to communicate complex engineering issues and concepts to technical and non-technical clients and project teams. Services may be provided for existing or proposed projects in the transportation sector.

Essential Roles and Responsibilities
  • Lead safety efforts for the team and ensure the team follows safety rules and guidelines.
  • Promote continuous quality monitoring and improvement on projects.
  • Responsible for conceptualizing the initial design and/or investigative approach for a major phase of a large project or have overall responsibility for the engineering work on a project of moderate scope.
  • Plan, schedule, conduct, and/or coordinate engineering work involving conventional engineering practices but may include a variety of complex features such as conflicting design requirements.
  • Provide review of projects requiring complex and innovative investigation techniques and supervise the analysis and formulation of recommendations in written reports to clients; provide technical review of reports.
  • Lead technical training and make informed decisions based upon state‑of‑the‑art technology issues.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Master's degree preferred
  • Minimum 8-11 years’ experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) registration.
  • Transportation experience with DOTs is required.
  • Valid driver’s license with acceptable violation history.
Examples of the work required include
  • Development of Site Characterization reports to include a geotechnical/geological narrative of site conditions along the alignment for purposes of identifying difficult ground conditions and/or project risks.
  • Providing geotechnical design recommendations and supporting documentation for earthwork, considering planned cuts/fills, for purposes of estimating construction quantities, assessing potential impacts to existing or planned project improvements and providing design/construction guidance.
  • Geotechnical design recommendations and supporting documentation for bridge and wall foundations (shallow and deep).
  • Geotechnical analysis to support retaining wall recommendations for individual retaining structures or for groups of retaining structures with the same general conditions (i.e. height, subgrade conditions, geometry, etc.). All analyses should be performed in accordance with code requirements.
Required analyses will include
  • External stability analysis (bearing resistance, sliding, overturning, eccentricity)
  • Settlement analyses (short‑term, total, rate)
  • Rotational stability
  • Identify geotechnical risk items that may adversely impact design and/or construction costs/schedules.

title: Pleegzorgbegeleider Regio Foodvalley/Eemland
description:
Ben jij er graag voor (pleeg)kinderen, ouder(s) en pleegouders, zodat kinderen kunnen opgroeien in een stabiele en fijne omgeving? Kom dan werken bij Timon.

Lees hieronder meer over onze actuele vacature pleegzorgbegeleider in regio Foodvalley en Eemland. De kantoorlocatie is Veenendaal.

Een stabiele en veilige omgeving is niet altijd vanzelfsprekend. Daar weten we bij Timon alles van. Lukt het echt niet thuis, dan is een pleeggezin vaak een oplossing, voor korte of langere tijd.

Als pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon ondersteun je (pleeg)kinderen, ouder(s) en pleegouders bij de uitdagingen waarvoor zij staan. Elke situatie is anders. Het kan gaan om een vrijwillige of gedwongen plaatsing in het eigen netwerk of bij een pleeggezin van Timon.

Dit ga je doen
  • Je ondersteunt het (pleeg)kind, de ouder(s) en pleegouders en werkt verbindend
  • Je stelt samen doelen op, legt die vast in een plan en gaat daarmee aan de slag
  • Je bent een klankbord voor ouder(s) en pleegouders en biedt handvatten voor het vormgeven van hun ouderrol op afstand/opvoedrol en rol binnen het zorgteam
  • Je houdt contact met instanties als school, GGZ, Jeugdbescherming en CJG
  • Je zorgt dat iedereen zich gehoord en gezien voelt
  • Je werkt zelfstandig en overlegt met collega's en de gedragswetenschapper

“Het mooist vind ik wanneer we samen met ouders en pleegouders een kind zien ontwikkelen.” – Nicole van Schaijk, pleegzorgbegeleider bij Timon.

Dit vragen we van je
  • Een relevant hbo-diploma (bijvoorbeeld Social Work of Pedagogiek)
  • Een geldige SKJ-registratie
  • Rijbewijs B en een auto
  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden
  • Een aantal jaar relevante werkervaring in de jeugd- of pleegzorg
Dit bieden wij
  • Op basis van een 36-urige werkweek kun je rekenen op: een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg (schaal 9) van €****,69 tot €****,96, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring
  • Een jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week. Functioneer je goed? Dan zetten we dit contract om in een vast dienstverband
  • 25 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantiegeld en reiskostenvergoeding
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% van je bruto jaarsalaris
  • Binnen Timon krijg je een uitgebreid inwerktraject waarin we je koppelen aan een buddy
  • Daarnaast volg je diverse trainingen en opleidingen gericht op jouw functie, zoals: Functiescholing pleegzorg, Contextuele hulpverlening en Traumasensitief werken

Wij zijn Timon. Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jou. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 800 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Solliciteer dan op de vacature voor pleegzorgbegeleider.

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Lucïenne Prinssen (teammanager). Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen met onze recruiters. Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Remote)
description:
Remote (North America/Latin America)

Maximus ( ) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

Maximus is building an advanced telemedicine platform to help men improve their mental and physical health. We iterate on our product rapidly and safely by applying continuous integration and code quality measurements, as well as TDD and pair programming when appropriate. We work collaboratively, emphasizing the productivity of the team first. We aim to deliver a robust, reliable system by using pragmatic, tried-and-true technologies. We hone our craft as engineers by applying advanced functional, data-oriented techniques that are appropriate to the problem.

Please note: Culture is key at Maximus, so we get to know candidates holistically through our questionnaire. You will receive an invite in a separate email upon submitting an application. Please fill it out as honestly and intuitively as possible since it is designed to detect exaggeration, which will cause your application to be automatically rejected. The questionnaire is optional to submit now with your application, but candidates that do so will get strongly prioritized. Note, we do not have access to individual questions’ answers/choices.

What We Are Looking For (Key Responsibilities)
  • Write and ship high quality code. Contribute across the codebase to complete entire features and changes with support from the rest of the team. Continuously invest in demonstrable quality and reliability of the system via unit tests, automated integration tests, TDD and refactoring. Keep data management and security in mind at all times to protect customer privacy.
  • Contribute to a continuously improving engineering organization. Identify software quality, performance, and operational issues, including impediments to team-wide efficiency and work constructively with the team to address them. Define and improve our internal engineering standards and processes and exert positive influence on the objectives and tactics taken by the team.
  • Contribute actively to product iteration and development to ensure the company delivers a compelling experience to its customers. Generate ideas and assess the associated options and tradeoffs for how they impact the growth of the business and customer experience. Work across functional teams (engineering, marketing, product, etc.) to translate business and product ideas into software designs and releases. Product & Project Management skills and experience are a plus.
Experience What we are looking for (Qualifications)
  • 6+ years of experience in product software development, especially public consumer web applications
  • Front-end: React/Redux/ImmutableJS experience
  • Back-end: Ruby-on-Rails / Ruby experience, GCP, AWS, Postgres
  • Ruby experience is highly preferred
General experience in unit testing, integration testing. Past experience or interest in pair programming. Experience experimenting and using the latest AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor etc.) Nice To Have
  • Familiarity with queue / background processing, 3rd party integrations (such as Stripe, or 3PL, etc.)
  • Familiarity with or interest in Event Sourcing and other immutability / functional-programming patterns.
  • TDD experience is a plus.
Qualities
  • A dedication to keeping things simple and pragmatic.
  • Attitude of shared ownership of the system, frequent integration. Collaborates proactively, in service of the shared highest priority.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills: Proven ability to build strong relationships with technical and non-technical members of the team to solve challenging technical and business problems.
  • Relentlessly Resourceful ( highly proactive, does not quit, and finds innovative solutions with little guidance. Bias for action and ability to thrive in an ambiguous environment with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Passion for Men’s Health & Development: interest in helping men develop a healthy masculinity. Demonstrates personal dedication and interest in health optimization (e.g. diet, exercise, sleep, focus, and relationships).
World-Class Benefits
  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Área responsável pela apuração dos impostos federais e municipais, além de atividades relacionadas a fiscalizações tributárias e legalização (CNPJS, CNDs, obrigações acessórias). Our Client This is a design‑led lifestyle and e‑commerce marketplace operating at the intersection of technology, art, and consumer retail. The organization connects a global community of independent artists with customers seeking distinctive, premium products across stationery, art, and home décor.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to drive the design, delivery, and evolution of core components within our Orders Platform, including cart, payments, shipping, and order management. This role spans end‑to‑end ownership from technical design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and production stability. You will build resilient, scalable e‑commerce microservices, integrate complex third‑party systems (payment gateways, shipping providers, compliance services), and ensure distributed data consistency across systems. The role includes contributing to the migration from a monolithic architecture to modern microservices, implementing decomposition strategies, and supporting frontend modernization efforts. You will design extensible RESTful APIs, optimize performance through caching and database improvements, manage infrastructure enhancements (Redis, CI/CD, Kubernetes), and proactively resolve production issues. In addition, you will mentor engineers, author technical design documents, and collaborate cross‑functionally to deliver stable, high‑impact features at scale.

Responsibilities
  • Lead component‑level projects (cart, payments, shipping, orders) across the Orders Platform, from design and implementation to deployment and monitoring.
  • Design and build resilient, scalable e‑commerce microservices (cart, payment gateways like CyberSource/Apple Pay/PayPal, shipping/fulfillment like FedEx/ShipEngine), ensuring distributed data consistency.
  • Drive the migration from a monolith to modern microservices using decomposition patterns (e.g., Strangler Fig) and modernize the frontend (React, CJS‑to‑ESM, Webpack‑to‑Vite).
  • Design and implement RESTful API services for various consumers, focusing on extensibility, caching (Redis/Valkey), and third‑party rate limiting.
  • Integrate third‑party payment and compliance systems (e.g., CyberSource MLE), adhering to security best practices and deadlines.
  • Create and maintain operational dashboards, monitoring, and alerting using Grafana, CloudWatch, and Sentry for system health and quick production issue identification.
  • Write extensible, well‑tested code with high unit test coverage, delivering stable features consistently.
  • Manage infrastructure tasks including Redis upgrades, database optimization (read replicas, slow query remediation), CI/CD improvements, and Helm/Kubernetes configuration.
  • Investigate and resolve production issues quickly, identifying root causes, predicting ramifications, and implementing preventative fixes.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and cross‑functional teams to meet requirements, proactively communicate status/blockers, and plan 1–2 weeks ahead.
  • Mentor engineers and interns, sharing system knowledge, best practices, and architectural decisions.
  • Author detailed technical design documents for complex projects, covering context, proposed approaches, performance, phased plans, and acceptance criteria.
Qualifications And Job Requirements
  • 8+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, with demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex, multi‑week projects independently.
  • A B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • Strong, hands‑on programming skills in Python (primary) with working knowledge of at least one additional language (JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, or similar).
  • Experience building and maintaining microservices and event‑driven systems (Kafka, message queues, async consumers) in a production environment.
  • Practical experience with monolith‑to‑microservice migration, decomposing legacy systems, managing dual‑write patterns, and incrementally routing traffic to new services.
  • Working knowledge of frontend technologies including React, TypeScript, and modern build tooling (Vite, Vitest); comfort working across the full stack when needed.
  • Experience with payment gateway integrations (CyberSource, PayPal, Apple Pay) including tokenization, encryption, and compliance requirements.
  • Familiarity with shipping and fulfillment systems, carrier API integrations (FedEx, UPS, USPS), tracking event processing, and delivery estimation logic is a plus.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud infrastructure: AWS (ElastiCache/Redis, CloudWatch, SNS, S3), Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred).
  • Strong understanding of database design and optimization, MySQL query performance, read replica strategies, caching layers (Redis/Memcached), and data consistency patterns.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools: Grafana, Prometheus, Sentry, CloudWatch, including building dashboards and configuring alerts proactively.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills; ability to write clear technical design documents and articulate decisions to engineers and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ownership mindset: follows through on tasks end‑to‑end, accepts responsibility for outcomes, and delights the end user.
  • The desire to ship is greater than the desire to polish.
  • Demonstrated willingness to use AI tools to assist in day‑to‑day work.
What we offer
  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.
  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market‑leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.
  • Paid Time Off: We value your well‑being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.
  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.
  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high‑impact projects with Industry‑Leading U.S. Companies.
Why You’ll Like Working Here
  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well‑being and work‑life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.
  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.
  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you’re working with the best in your field.

title: Solutions Architect, LATAM CSC (AWS)
description:
Do you get energized helping customers solve complex problems—not just on a whiteboard, but by building alongside them?

We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our CSC Brazil team, working with enterprise customers across the full breadth of their cloud journey. You'll help customers migrate to the cloud, modernize legacy applications and databases, build cloud‑native solutions, and explore how GenAI & Agentic AI can drive their business forward.

We value practitioners—people whose judgment is grounded in real‑world experience building and shipping solutions. You'll partner hands‑on with customers, turning ideas into working prototypes and production‑ready architectures. Whether the challenge is a complex migration, a legacy modernization, a greenfield application, or helping a customer understand how AI can transform their business—you'll bring curiosity, technical depth, and a bias for action.

If you thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly when priorities shift, and measure your success by the outcomes you help customers achieve—we'd love to hear from you.

We value diversity in all its forms — we believe that teams made up of people with different backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking are more creative, innovative, and resilient. Here, every voice matters and contributes to our collective growth.

Key job responsibilities
  • Partner with enterprise customers to design, build, and implement solutions across cloud adoption, migration, modernization, and new workloads.
  • Work hands‑on with customer and partner teams—building prototypes, proofs of concept, and production‑ready architectures together.
  • Guide customers through cloud migrations—helping them move workloads efficiently and securely.
  • Help customers explore how AI and emerging technologies can enhance their applications, operations, and customer experiences.
  • Share knowledge broadly through workshops, technical content, and community engagement.
About the team

You’ll be part of the AWS CSC Solutions Architecture team. We work with enterprise customers across industries—helping them adopt cloud, migrate and modernize their technology landscape, adopt AI, and build for the future. Our team values builders who are curious, collaborative, and customer‑obsessed. We learn from each other, support each other’s growth, and celebrate diverse perspectives. Whether you’re presenting to executives or coding alongside engineers, you’ll find a team that values both technical depth and human connection.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee‑led and company‑sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge‑sharing, mentorship and other career‑advancing resources here to help you develop into a better‑rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work‑life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience.
  • 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience.
  • Experience in English‑language communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Knowledge of programming or other scripting languages and coding skills (C/C++/C#, Node.JS, Java, Python, PHP, Ruby).
  • Foundational knowledge of generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and machine learning concepts, with strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to apply ML techniques to real‑world applications.
  • Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Curious & have experimented with AI and emerging technologies—and how they can augment human builders and drive business outcomes—with experience helping customers evaluate or implement AI/ML solutions.
  • 5+ years of experience architecting, migrating, or building solutions on cloud platforms, with hands‑on experience with AWS services. Desirable knowledge of AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Q, Amazon Rekognition, Amazon Comprehend, or Amazon Transcribe.

Thought Leadership: Champion innovative approaches, industry best practices, and emerging trends in portfolio management. Mentor and develop team members, fostering a culture of excellence, agility, and high performance.

title: Especialista de SIG (Sistema de Informações Geográficas)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Coletar, organizar, analisar e representar dados geográficos para apoiar decisões técnicas, ambientais, urbanas, de todas as concessões da EPR. Atuar de forma corporativa e colaborativa garantindo uniformidade nas soluções e decisões. Atuar como integrador e agregador nos quesitos de informações geoespaciais, provocando e trazendo novas ideias, buscando o atendimento ao contrato de concessão das concessionárias. Promover a inovação dos processos junto às plataformas de gerenciamento de informações geográficas de forma a agregar valor ao grupo EPR.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Criar e manter os SIG´s (Sistemas de Informação Geográfica) de todas as concessões do grupo EPR, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais. Inserir e manter atualizadas todas as informações espaciais fornecidas pelas concessionárias, buscando inclusão com informações auxiliares de cadastros públicos ou outros que puderem ser incorporados. Dentro do possível, inserindo cadastros de interferências e propriedades lindeiras que sejam passíveis de desapropriações em projetos de engenharia. Criar e manter bases de dados espaciais atualizadas, organizados, integrados. Garantir integração das informações inseridas no SIG com outros sistemas e plataformas da EPR. Garantir a evolução e desenvolvimento contínuo de rotinas com busca a potencializar a ferramenta, garantindo agregação de valor em todas as frentes de atuação. Criar e manter hierarquia de acesso à informação, seja por administradores do sistema, usuários internos (colaboradores EPR) do sistema e usuários externos (poder concedente). Sempre em acordo com à LGPD pertinente. Gerar mapas temáticos e relatórios que permitam visualizações e apresentações relevantes para as concessionárias e para a diretoria da EPR, sempre buscando o atendimento contratual e agregação de valor. Propor e desenvolver rotinas e modelagens que permitam um “novo olhar” para a malha rodoviária e ativos do grupo EPR. Tais modelagens devem buscar integrar e combinar dados, como por exemplo: aspectos de geometria das vias, dados de tráfego, dados meteorológicos, dados de acidentes, obras estruturantes, entre outros. Apoiar outras áreas e orientar quanto ao uso de sensoriamento remoto, uso de imagens de satélite, drones, monitoramento ambiental entre outros. Apoiar e orientar outras áreas da EPR para garantir sinergia de atividades e serviços, sempre focado na melhoria da qualidade e redução de CAPEX e/ou OPEX.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino Superior completo ou curso técnico profissionalizante na área de gestão, administração ou manipulação de informações geoespaciais;
  • Mínimo de 8 anos comprovado em plataformas de SIG, tendo feito análises espaciais e tendo desenvolvido rotinas e programações de otimizações e Inteligências Artificias em modelos espaciais;
  • Domínio de plataformas como QGIS, ArcGIS, Google Earth, AutoCAD Map, Python. Espera-se que o profissional tenha experiência em ambiente de SIG, tendo feito gestão de grandes investimentos nas plataformas espaciais. Espera-se também que o profissional tenha trabalhado com programação de rotinas que acelerem as análises e otimizem recursos.
Requisitos desejáveis
  • 12 anos de atuação direta no mercado de empresas de concessões de serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento avançado em PostGIS, JavaScript, SQL.

Description

A OZ Minerals é uma empresa de mineração moderna, focada em desenvolvimento de pessoas. Assim que o novo contratado começa a trabalhar conosco, se torna um membro respeitado do time com papéis e responsabilidades que contribuirão positivamente para o sucesso de todos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais para atuar como Geotécnico Sr em Água Azul do Norte - PA.

Responsibilities

Responsável pelas análises técnicas de estabilidade e elaboração de projetos de suporte. Principal função é garantir que as análises e projetos sejam gerenciados a um nível que a empresa possa utilizá-los para o planejamento de curto e médio prazo.

Reporta diretamente ao Coordenador de geotecnia que inserida na Gerencia de Serviços Técnicos.

Liderar e orientar equipe de engenharia/geologia.

Gestão de contratos com fornecedores de serviços de consultoria ou execução de obras.

  • Realizar inspeções de rotina em mina subterrânea, cava a céu aberto e pilha de estéril;
  • Realizar a avaliação de projetos do planejamento de curto e médio prazo, com foco no dimensionamento e análise de estabilidade de painéis de lavra (stopes, sill pillar, rib pillar; galerias de infraestrutura, rampa); dimensionamento e estabilidade de taludes e pilhas de estéril (largura, altura, ângulo de berma e talude geral);
  • Realizar o controle de qualidade, análise e interpretação da base de dados geotécnicos;

  • Experiencia com uso de software de aplicação a geotecnia (Map3D, RocData, RS2, RS3, Gem4D, Dips, Unwedge, Slide 2 e 3D, GeoStudio, Leapfrog, etc);
  • Experiencia com sistemas de classificação e caracterização geotecnico (RMR, Q-Barton, RQD, SME;
  • Experiencia com métodos de lavra subterrâneo e céu aberto;
  • Experiencia com as técnicas de análise de estabilidade por métodos empíricos (Mathew, Potvin), equilíbrio limite (Fellenius, Bishop, Morgenstern- Price, Janbu), modelagem 2d ou 3D, análise cinemática;
  • Experiencia no uso de modelos constitutivos e de resistência/ruptura de materiais (Hoek-Brown, Mohr-Coulomb, Barton-Bandis);

  • Pós-graduação: especialização;

  • Estabelecer a Gestão de Riscos do Portfólio, utilizando ferramentas quantitativas e qualitativas para planos de mitigação e contingência.
  • Promover a Integração Multidisciplinar, atuando como interface entre as áreas de engenharia, suprimentos, financeiro e operações para eliminar gargalos.
  • Garantir o Compliance e ESG, assegurando que todos os projetos de engenharia sigam as diretrizes de sustentabilidade e normas regulatórias do setor.
  • Desenvolver o Time de Planejamento, disseminando uma cultura de alta performance, melhoria contínua e foco em resultados.

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia (Elétrica, Mecânica, Civil, Produção, Ambiental ou Química).

Realizar avaliação de saúde pré e pós viagem;

Realizar avaliação médica e/ou participar de junta multidisciplinar para avaliação de enquadramento de Pessoa com Deficiência (PCD) para integrar cota;

Elaborar e registrar no sistema informatizado laudo de transferência para fins de Exame Médico de Mudança de Riscos Ocupacionais, com definição de realização de exames complementares, caso necessário;

Avaliar a capacidade laborativa e homologar atestados médicos dos considerados totalmente incapazes para o trabalho, registrando os dados clínicos e suas impressões, bem como as licenças médicas aplicáveis no Sistema Informatizado de Saúde, realizando os desdobramentos necessários;

Realizar exame pericial para homologação presencial de atestado médico;

Acompanhar empregados afastados em benefício previdenciário, assim como fazer visitas domiciliares, hospitalares e/ou ao INSS quando necessário;

Avaliar as condições de saúde do empregado, com o objetivo de identificar possibilidades de reinserção em atividade laboral compatível com o estado de saúde ou agravos potenciais à saúde, e definir estratégias de intervenção;

Elaborar laudo médico justificando a necessidade de manutenção do afastamento e prognóstico,em caso de inaptidão ao trabalho;

Emitir pareceres e/ou relatórios acerca das conclusões referentes à capacidade laborativa e/ou incapacidades temporárias parciais que impliquem na mudança do regime de trabalho ou das atividades exercidas, descrevendo as restrições para determinadas atividades laborativas, bem como suas causas e prazos para reavaliação médica;

Investigar e estabelecer nexo-causal em parceria com o profissional da PETROBRAS;

Preencher CAT no Sistema Informatizado de Saúde, bem como emitir os comunicados cabíveis às partes envolvidas (internas e externas à Companhia) em relação ao processo de Gestão de Anomalias e Acidentes de Trabalho, além de atuação na classificação e caracterização de ocorrências, de acordo com normas e diretrizes da PETROBRAS;

Analisar as causas de absenteísmo por doença ou acidente do órgão operacional;

Participar de atendimentos e inspeções de saúde nas áreas operacionais;

Avaliar condições de trabalho dos acidentados em conjunto com o próprio acidentado e com a comissão de investigação de acidentes, quando demandado, seguindo os procedimentos internos;

Realizar visita médica hospitalar ou domiciliar a empregados, se demandado, emitir relatório pós visita e registrar dados no prontuário eletrônico.

Participar de junta médica para conclusão de avaliação clínica;

Atuar em equipe multiprofissional, acompanhamento individual interdisciplinar em saúde e atuar como matriciador na discussão técnica dos casos acompanhados;

Realizar análise das condições de trabalho, relações sociais, orientação e encaminhamento para Programas de Saúde e Serviço Social;

Realizar interface com médico assistente para adequado subsídio nas avaliações pertinentes ao médico do trabalho, quando necessário;

Desenvolver ações estruturadas, integradas aos diversos programas desenvolvidos na Companhia;

Elaborar relatórios e painéis gerenciais de planejamento e apoiar na apuração dos indicadores, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas de gestão da PETROBRAS;

Formular pareceres técnicos sobre assuntos de sua especialidade, prestando assessoramento àsgerências da PETROBRAS, quando demandado;

Realizar análise crítica de registros em prontuário médico com elaboração de resumos e/ou relatórios, inclusive contestação de nexo causal, entre outros solicitados pela equipe da PETROBRAS;

Assessorar, planejar, gerir e realizar consolidação e análise crítica de dados;

Propor, planejar e executar atividades coletivas, promovendo espaços de diálogo e utilizando estratégias adequadas para sensibilização, engajamento e protagonismo dos trabalhadores;

Transcrever para o Sistema Informatizado da Petrobras o registro de exames ocupacionais realizados por profissionais externos;

Assumir responsabilidade técnica do serviço junto ao conselho profissional da categoria, quando necessário;

Registrar as informações e atendimento em formulários próprios e/ou sistemas informatizados;Atuar em atendimentos de urgências e emergências em caráter eventual com suporte às equipes de prontidão, cabendo para tal a realização de treinamentos específicos ofertados pela Petrobras;

Realizar as atribuições profissionais descritas na Lei nº 12.842/13 e suas alterações, Resolução CFM nº 2297/21, bem como às demais normas emitidas pelo Conselho Federal de Medicina (CFM), Conselho Regional de Medicina do Estado (CRM), Normas Regulamentadoras do Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego (NR’s) e legislação vigente aplicável.

Conhecimento e/ou experiência comprovada nos conceitos de atendimento em saúde do trabalhador dentro de organizações.

Possuir habilidades profissionais para trabalho em equipe, flexibilidade, proatividade, organização e comprometimento.

Experiencia mínima de acima de 6 (seis) anos na atividade de médico do trabalho.

Overview

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira.

E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você! Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula – onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará – com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas – as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Vantagens
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade.
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações.
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas.
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil.
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Aptidão para vendas.
  • Amplo círculo social (network/rede de relacionamento).
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais.
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor.
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações Adicionais
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio.
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam.
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social.
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho.
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais.
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais.
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.
Sobre a MAG

Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host City Manager – Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines. The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas. The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities. The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília. Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.
Your Profile Education
  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.
Experience
  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).
Behavioral Competencies
  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.

title: Compliance Director
description:
DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

We are seeking a Senior Compliance Officer to serve as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to our commercial operations in Brazil. Your mission is to integrate compliance seamlessly into business strategy and daily operations, enabling sustainable growth. You will be embedded within business units, working closely with Sales, Products, Operations, Marketing and HR leadership to provide pragmatic guidance on complex commercial practices, regulatory challenges and employee relations.

In this role, you'll be…
  • Act as the primary, dedicated compliance advisor to assigned business units, proactively participating in business meetings and strategic initiatives to provide forward-looking, risk-based solutions.
  • Offer clear, actionable counsel on complex compliance matters involving third-party management, gifts & hospitality, conflicts of interest, anti-corruption, anti-fraud, etc. in day-to-day operations.
  • Lead compliance risk assessments for new business initiatives, market campaigns, and partnerships, designing effective and business-practical mitigation controls.
  • Monitor the regulatory landscape and ensure the company's practices remain compliant with new laws, translate regulatory requirements and internal policies into clear business language and processes.
  • Develop and deliver engaging, scenario-based compliance training tailored to specific business functions, empowering line managers and employees.
  • Champion a culture of integrity and ethical decision-making through daily interactions and advisory support.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for compliance concerns arising within the business, identifying any potential misconduct, fraud, corruption and violations of Code of Conduct.
  • Lead and conduct confidential internal investigations into allegations of misconduct, fraud, corruption, and violations of the Code of Conduct, prepare clear, concise, and well-documented investigation reports for senior management.
We're eager to be in touch because you have…
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law or a related field. A post-graduate degree is a plus.
  • Demonstrable expertise in three key areas: Brazilian Labor Law, internal investigations, and compliance program management.
  • 10+ years of proven experience in compliance, internal audit, or a related field, with a significant portion dedicated to conducting internal investigations.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to provide pragmatic, risk-based advice to senior stakeholders.
  • Proven leadership skills and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent project management and problem-solving abilities.
  • Exceptional interviewing, analytical, and report-writing skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and professional proficiency in English.
You'll love working at DiDi because…

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration. Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth. We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion. Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .
